subject.title: Doubao: query Coding/Agent Plan usage via arkcli CLI

question: Should existing Doubao AK/SK usage remain supported while arkcli becomes the preferred automatic source, or is an intentional breaking removal acceptable for this release?
rationale: The branch currently removes a shipped credential workflow, and source inspection cannot determine whether maintainers intend that upgrade break or require a compatibility transition.

options.title: Preserve compatibility
options.body: Keep AK/SK as a fallback or deprecated strategy while adding arkcli as a distinct CLI source and preserving deterministic explicit-source behavior.

options.title: Approve a breaking transition
options.body: Remove AK/SK only with explicit maintainer approval, corrected settings and documentation, release-facing migration guidance, and fresh-install plus upgrade proof.

options.title: Pause the integration
options.body: Hold the PR until arkcli output stability and supported installation/authentication expectations are confirmed.

recommendation.title: Preserve compatibility
recommendation.body: Keep AK/SK as a fallback or deprecated strategy while adding arkcli as a distinct CLI source and preserving deterministic explicit-source behavior.

likelyOwner.reason: As repository and release owner, steipete is the best available person to decide whether a shipped authentication path may be removed.
